overview: The School Committee met in a special remote session to consider and approve updates to the Chapter 74 viability form for the new Medford High School project.

items.title: Updated Chapter 74 Viability Form
items.summary: Approved the updated Chapter 74 viability form for the new Medford High School project, which incorporates current enrollment, waitlist data, and revised program timelines requested by the Massachusetts School Building Authority.
